llms.body:
# Olark

> Olark is live chat and AI chat software for websites. These are Olark's help center articles and JavaScript API reference. Articles marked "Olark Classic" cover the legacy version of the product.

- [Help Center](https://www.olark.com/help/): setup, installation, integrations, billing and troubleshooting
- [JavaScript API](https://www.olark.com/api/): customize and control the chat box from your site's code
- [Contact support](https://www.olark.com/help/ticket/)


## Billing

- [Billing errors](https://www.olark.com/help/billing-errors/): Olark card payment declined? See common causes like insufficient funds, fraud flags or blocked international charges, and what to ask your bank.
- [How to Add a Payment Method](https://www.olark.com/help/add-a-payment-method/): Add a payment card to your Olark account from the Billing section of the Admin interface in a few quick steps.
- [Price Changes FAQ](https://www.olark.com/help/price-changes-2023/): Why your Olark plan price changed in 2023, how and when you'll be notified, when new pricing takes effect, and where to compare current plans.
- [Refunds](https://www.olark.com/help/refunds/): How to request a refund from Olark after canceling your plan or PowerUp, when full or partial refunds apply, and how far back requests can go.
- [W9 Form](https://www.olark.com/help/w9-form/): Find Olark's tax ID number, which is also its TIN and EIN, and download a signed copy of Olark's W9 form, or request one by email.

## Getting Started

- [Adding a Click-to-Chat Link](https://www.olark.com/help/addimage/): Make any link, image or button on your site open the Olark chat box, using copy-and-paste HTML examples built on the Olark JavaScript API.
- [Automated email reports](https://www.olark.com/help/automated-email-reports/): Set up daily, weekly or monthly Olark email reports on agent activity, chat ratings, transcripts and workload. Available to admins on paid plans.
- [Consent for Recording Chat Messages](https://www.olark.com/help/consent/): Why the Olark chatbox tells visitors that chats are recorded, and how to add similar consent language to your own welcome or offline message.
- [Email a Transcript to a Visitor](https://www.olark.com/help/send/): Use the !send command to email an Olark chat transcript to the visitor or any address during a chat, plus notes on errors and delivery notifications.
- [Emailed CSV reports](https://www.olark.com/help/email-report/): Field-by-field reference for Olark's emailed CSV chat reports, covering chat timing, agent response delays, visitor details and transcript metadata.
- [Get Feedback with Chat Ratings](https://www.olark.com/help/chat-ratings/): Turn on Olark Chat Ratings to send visitors a five-question post-chat survey with !feedback or !end, and see how agents get notified of written feedback.
- [How do I install Olark on my page?](https://www.olark.com/help/html/): Find your Olark install code and site ID in Chat Widget settings, then add the snippet before your site's closing body tag or install via a CMS plugin.
- [Limiting Chats Per Agent](https://www.olark.com/help/limit/): Cap concurrent chats per Olark agent with the 'next agent in line' routing option, and see what visitors get when every agent is at their limit.
- [My chat box does not display](https://www.olark.com/help/stuck/): Olark chatbox not showing on your site? Work through common causes, from badly pasted code and private browsing to hide-when-offline settings.
- [Offline chatbox options](https://www.olark.com/help/offline-options/): Choose what the Olark chat box does when no agents or bots are available: hide it, show a static offline message, or collect visitor details with a form.
- [Password recovery](https://www.olark.com/help/password/): Reset a forgotten Olark password from the login page, plus what to do if you sign in with SSO, use non-Latin characters, or try a billing email.
- [Removal, Cancellation & Deletion](https://www.olark.com/help/delete-account/): Remove an agent from your Olark team, cancel your subscription from the Billing page, or request permanent deletion of your Olark account.
- [Safari Notifications](https://www.olark.com/help/safarinotifications/): Hear Olark chat sound alerts in Safari by changing the Auto-Play setting for app.olark.com from 'Stop Media with Sound' to 'Allow All Auto-Play'.
- [Transcripts](https://www.olark.com/help/view-transcripts/): Read and search all your Olark conversations on the Transcripts page, find a live chat's transcript link, and see what each transcript includes.
- [Transferring a Chat](https://www.olark.com/help/transfers/): Transfer an Olark chat with the !transfer command, either open to all agents, directly to one agent with @name or to a group with #groupname.
- [Using the Chatbox for Offline Messages](https://www.olark.com/help/offline-message-emails/): Turn the Olark chatbox into an offline message form when no agents or bots are available, and choose which name, email and phone fields to collect.
- [What Kind of Reporting Olark Offers](https://www.olark.com/help/reports/): An overview of Olark's reporting options, including chat ratings, emailed CSV reports, agent activity metrics and Google Analytics tracking.
- [Why am I not getting notifications?](https://www.olark.com/help/notification-troubleshooting/): Not getting Olark chat notifications? Check browser site permissions, OS Focus and Do Not Disturb settings, and your Olark alert sound volume.

## Historical Olark

- [Adium setup guide](https://www.olark.com/help/adium/): Connect Adium to your Olark account over XMPP/Jabber to answer chats from a Mac, including the port and connect server settings to use if it won't connect.
- [Desk integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/desk/): Olark retired its Desk.com integration on August 31, 2019 after ongoing reliability problems. Read why the integration was discontinued.
- [Highrise integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/highrise/): Olark retired its Highrise CRM integration on August 31, 2019. You can still send Olark data to Highrise using webhooks or Zapier.
- [Mismatched names in Adium](https://www.olark.com/help/mismatched-names/): Fix mismatched visitor names when using Adium with Olark by turning off the setting that shows recent messages in new chats.
- [Pidgin auto-away](https://www.olark.com/help/pidgin-auto-away/): Pidgin can set your Olark status to away when your computer is idle. Change or disable auto-away in Pidgin's Status/Idle preferences.
- [Pidgin setup guide](https://www.olark.com/help/pidgin/): Set up Pidgin on Windows to answer Olark chats by adding your Olark account with the XMPP (Jabber) protocol and olark.com domain.
- [Pidgin spell checker](https://www.olark.com/help/pidgin-spellcheck/): Enable spell checking in Pidgin for Olark chats by rerunning the Pidgin installer and selecting Spellchecking Support for your language.
- [Trillian setup guide](https://www.olark.com/help/trillian-ios/): Answer Olark chats on the go by setting up the Trillian app on iOS or Android with your Olark mobile app username and password.
- [Trillian setup guide (Desktop Client)](https://www.olark.com/help/trillian-desktop/): Set up Trillian on Windows or Mac to answer Olark chats from a desktop client, including adding your account with your Olark username and @olark.com.
- [Troubleshooting with the mmenu plugin](https://www.olark.com/help/mmenu/): The jQuery mmenu plugin removes the Olark chat box by default. Fix it with the Olark wrapper available in mmenu 5.4.1, plus troubleshooting tips.
- [Using Olark with jquery.prettyPhoto](https://www.olark.com/help/jquery-prettyphoto/): Visitors can't type in the Olark chat box on pages using jQuery prettyPhoto? Add a small workaround to your prettyPhoto config to fix keyboard input.
- [Using Pidgin from behind a firewall](https://www.olark.com/help/pidgin-firewall/): Connect Pidgin to Olark from behind a company firewall by setting the connect server to port80.olark.com and the port to 80 in advanced settings.
- [Why does my chatbox look giant?](https://www.olark.com/help/doctype/): Is your Olark chat box displaying much larger than normal? The usual cause is a missing or transitional doctype declaration, and here is how to fix it.
- [Wix HTML5 Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/wix-html5/): Olark is not supported on Wix sites. Find out why the Wix HTML element's sandboxed iframe prevents the Olark code snippet from working.

## Installation

- [3DCart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/3dcart/): Add Olark live chat to a 3DCart store by pasting your embed code into each page template in the 3DCart Template Editor, just above the closing body tag.
- [Big Cartel integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/bigcartel/): Install the Olark chat box on a Big Cartel store by pasting your embed code into the custom layout. Requires a paid Big Cartel plan to edit the HTML.
- [BigCommerce Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/bigcommerce/): Install Olark live chat on a BigCommerce store, with steps for Blueprint (legacy) themes via footer scripts and Stencil themes via Live Chat settings.
- [Blogger integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/blogger/): Add Olark live chat to a Blogger blog with an HTML/JavaScript gadget, plus a note on Google occasionally removing blogs that use third-party scripts.
- [Constant Contact integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/constant-contact/): Install the Olark chat box on a Constant Contact website by pasting your Olark code snippet into Footer HTML injection and publishing the site.
- [CS-Cart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/cscart/): Install Olark live chat on a CS-Cart store by adding your embed code to the index.tpl template between literal tags, then clearing the CS-Cart cache.
- [Cubecart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/cubecart/): Enable Olark live chat on a CubeCart store using the built-in Live Help module: select Olark, enter your Site ID, switch the module on and save.
- [Drupal integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/drupal/): Install Olark live chat on a Drupal site by adding your install code to a custom block, with steps for Drupal 8 and 9 and the deprecated Drupal 7.
- [ekmPowershop integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/ekmpowershop/): Add Olark live chat to an ekmPowershop store by switching to a custom template design and pasting your Olark embed code into the template editor.
- [GoDaddy Website Builder Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/godaddy/): Olark usually won't work properly with GoDaddy Website Builder due to widget positioning issues. See the conflicts and GoDaddy's third-party script option.
- [Google Tag Manager](https://www.olark.com/help/google-tag-manager/): Install Olark through Google Tag Manager with a DOM Ready trigger and a Custom HTML tag. Olark does not recommend this method and cannot troubleshoot it.
- [Joomla integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/joomla/): Add Olark live chat to a Joomla 3 site using the Custom HTML Advanced module, placing your Olark install code in a footer module position.
- [Joomla integration guide (pre v3)](https://www.olark.com/help/joomla-legacy/): Install Olark live chat on older Joomla sites, versions 1.5, 1.6 and 2.5, by adding your embed code through the template manager or a custom HTML module.
- [Magento integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/magento-manual/): Install Olark live chat on a Magento 1 or Magento 2 store by pasting your embed code into the footer's Miscellaneous HTML field in Design Configuration.
- [Moodle Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/moodle/): Add Olark live chat to a Moodle learning site by pasting your install code into the Additional HTML 'Before BODY is closed' section of Appearance settings.
- [OpenCart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/opencart/): Install Olark live chat on an OpenCart store by editing your theme's footer.tpl file over FTP or cPanel and pasting in your Olark embed code.
- [osCommerce integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/oscommerce/): Install Olark live chat on an osCommerce store by editing a PHP include file such as footer.php in the File Manager and pasting your embed code.
- [Pinnacle Cart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/pinnacle-cart/): Add Olark live chat to a Pinnacle Cart store by pasting your Olark embed code into the Analytics Tracking field under Marketing, Google Tools.
- [Prestashop integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/prestashop/): Install Olark on PrestaShop 1.5 and later by editing your theme's footer.tpl over FTP and wrapping the Olark code in literal tags.
- [Prestashop integration guide (pre v1.5)](https://www.olark.com/help/prestashop-legacy/): Install Olark live chat on PrestaShop 1.4.9 and earlier by pasting your embed code into the theme's footer.tpl file via FTP or cPanel File Manager.
- [Shopify integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/shopify/): Install Olark live chat on a Shopify store by pasting your embed code into the theme layout file, and optionally show cart details with the API.
- [Squarespace Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/squarespace6/): Add the Olark chat box to a Squarespace site by pasting your Olark install code into the Header field under Settings, Advanced, Code Injection.
- [Template integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/templates/): Using a CMS theme with Olark built in? Swap the template's Site ID for your own so the pre-installed chat box connects to your Olark account.
- [Ubercart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/ubercart/): Add Olark live chat to an Ubercart store on Drupal 6 by pasting your embed code into a Full HTML block placed in the footer.
- [VirtueMart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/virtuemart/): Install Olark live chat on a VirtueMart store running on Joomla by pasting your Olark code snippet into your template's HTML in the Template Manager.
- [Volusion integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/volusion/): Install Olark live chat on a Volusion store by pasting your Olark code snippet before the closing body tag in the LiveEdit File Editor.
- [Weebly Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/weebly/): Install Olark live chat on a Weebly website by pasting your Olark code snippet into the Footer Code section of the SEO settings, then publishing.
- [What website builder tools do not work with Olark?](https://www.olark.com/help/webscom/): Some website builders are known to conflict with the Olark chat widget. See which ones, including GoDaddy, Webs.com and Wix, Olark does not recommend.
- [WHMCS integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/whmcs/): Install Olark live chat on WHMCS by editing your theme's footer.tpl over FTP, pasting the Olark code above the body tag and wrapping it in literal tags.
- [WordPress Integration Guide (Manual Install)](https://www.olark.com/help/wordpress/): Install Olark on a WordPress site manually by pasting your code snippet into a Custom HTML widget, or use the recommended Olark WordPress plugin instead.
- [WordPress Integration Guide (Plugin Install)](https://www.olark.com/help/wordpress-plugin/): Install Olark on a WordPress site with the Olark Live Chat plugin: add it from Plugins, enter your Site ID, and enable the chatbox in its settings.
- [X-Cart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/x-cart/): Install Olark live chat on an X-Cart store by adding the Livechat - Olark module from the Extensions Marketplace in your store admin.
- [Zen Cart integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/zen-cart/): Add Olark live chat to a Zen Cart store by pasting your code snippet at the bottom of the tpl_footer.php template file via cPanel or FTP.

## Integrations

- [ActiveCampaign integration guide (via Zapier)](https://www.olark.com/help/activecampaign/): Connect Olark to ActiveCampaign through Zapier and a webhook so new chat messages and transcripts create or update ActiveCampaign contacts.
- [ActiveDEMAND integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/activedemand/): Connect Olark to ActiveDEMAND so chat conversations and visitor emails land in your marketing timeline, and use the !ad_info command during chats.
- [Advanced SalesForce Field Mapping](https://www.olark.com/help/custom-salesforce/): Use the Olark API to fill custom Salesforce lead and case fields from chats, with examples of value and transcript field types and naming.
- [Calendly Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/calendly/): Share your Calendly scheduling link in Olark chats by saving it as an Agent Tools shortcut, then sending it with a quick semicolon command like ;cal.
- [Conversion tracking with Google Analytics](https://www.olark.com/help/google-analytics-conversion/): Measure whether Olark chat drives sales by comparing chatting and non-chatting visitor segments in Google Analytics. Covers deprecated Universal Analytics.
- [Custom Integrations](https://www.olark.com/help/custom-integrations/): Need an integration Olark doesn't offer out of the box? Compare two custom options: webhooks for transcript data and the JavaScript API for chatbox events.
- [Freshdesk integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/freshdesk/): Send Olark chat transcripts and offline messages to Freshdesk by entering your Freshdesk email in Behavior settings. Works on Sprout through Estate plans.
- [Getting started with Google Analytics (GA4) integration](https://www.olark.com/help/google_analytics/): Turn on Olark's Google Analytics (GA4) integration to send chat events to your GA4 account, with notes on Google Tag Manager setups and data delays.
- [Google Meet Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/meet/): Share a Google Meet link in Olark chats with a shortcut. Set up a permanent Meet link via a recurring Calendar event, then add it in Agent Tools.
- [GreenRope integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/greenrope/): Integrate Olark with the GreenRope CRM to forward chat transcripts and visitor info, using the webhook URL from GreenRope's Chat settings.
- [Help Scout integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/helpscout/): Connect Olark to Help Scout with a webhook URL so chat transcripts and offline messages are sent to your Help Scout help desk automatically.
- [Hubspot integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/hubspot/): Connect Olark to HubSpot to send chat transcripts to contact timelines, see which fields are sent, or add the Olark chat box to a HubSpot-hosted site.
- [Mailchimp Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/mailchimp/): Connect Olark to Mailchimp and add chat participants to a chosen Mailchimp list with a chat command. Covers authentication and setup steps.
- [Nutshell integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/nutshell/): Connect Olark to Nutshell to save chat transcripts as activities on contacts, accounts and leads, so chats appear next to emails and calls.
- [Pardot Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/pardot/): Use Pardot's Olark integration to score prospects who chat and attach chat transcripts to their records. The integration is added from inside Pardot.
- [Qualaroo integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/qualaroo/): Qualaroo, an analytics and A/B testing tool, can start an Olark chat based on how a visitor answers a survey question. Links to Qualaroo's setup guide.
- [Reporting insights from Google Analytics](https://www.olark.com/help/google-analytics-insight/): Use Olark's Google Analytics events to see how busy chat is and which visitors and pages lead to chats. Written for Universal Analytics, sunset June 2023.
- [Salesforce Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/salesforce/): Connect Olark to Salesforce to create leads or cases from chats with !salesforce commands or automatically, and see the Salesforce plan requirements.
- [Setting up the GA4 integration with Google Tag Manager](https://www.olark.com/help/setting-up-ga4-with-google-tag-manager/): Track Olark chat events in GA4 loaded through Google Tag Manager by adding the required data layer variables, custom event triggers and a GA4 event tag.
- [Slack Integration Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/slack/): Connect Olark to Slack to set your chat status through the Olark bot and receive real-time alerts. Chatting with visitors from Slack is now deprecated.
- [SugarCRM integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/sugar/): Connect Olark to SugarCRM to send chat transcripts automatically or create leads during a chat with the !sugarcrm command, plus how to send a test case.
- [The Complete Guide to Connecting Technolutions Slate and Olark Live Chat](https://www.olark.com/help/slate/): Connect Technolutions Slate to Olark to log chats as interactions, link agents to student records and improve lead scoring, with step-by-step setup.
- [Troubleshooting Google Analytics](https://www.olark.com/help/google-analytics-troubleshooting/): Fix common problems with Olark events missing from Google Analytics, such as multiple site IDs on a page. Covers Universal Analytics, sunset June 2023.
- [Using multiple Google Analytics tracking IDs](https://www.olark.com/help/google-analytics-tracking-id/): Using several Google Analytics IDs on one page? Tell Olark which Universal Analytics ID to send events to. Universal Analytics has since been sunset.
- [Webflow integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/webflow/): Add Olark live chat to a Webflow site by pasting your installation code into the Footer Code box in Project Settings. Requires a paid Webflow plan.
- [Webhooks integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/webhooks/): Send Olark chat transcripts to your own server with a webhook. See how the HTTP POST works and an example of the JSON-encoded transcript format.
- [Why does Magento show incorrect user information?](https://www.olark.com/help/magento-incorrect-data/): Magento can show a previous visitor's details or CartSaver cart in Olark. See the settings that cause it and the recommended configuration workaround.
- [WooCommerce integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/woocommerce/): Use WooCommerce with Olark's WordPress plugin and Cart Saver to see what's in a visitor's shopping cart while you chat in the Olark Classic chat console.
- [Zapier integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/zapier/): Connect Olark to Zapier with a webhook to send new messages or transcripts to thousands of apps, such as archiving chats in Google Sheets.
- [Zendesk integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/zendesk/): Connect Olark to Zendesk with an API token to create tickets from chats using the !zendesk command or send every chat to Zendesk automatically.
- [Zoom integration guide](https://www.olark.com/help/zoom/): Invite chat visitors to a Zoom call by saving your personal Zoom meeting link as an Olark Shortcut you can send by typing ;zoom.

## New Olark

- [Accessibility](https://www.olark.com/help/accessibility/): Olark's chatbox widget meets WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508 requirements. See how Olark approaches accessibility and find resources to learn more.
- [Accessing Visitor IP Addresses in Olark](https://www.olark.com/help/ipaddress/): Find where visitor IP addresses live in Olark: copy them from the chat console, use them to block trolls, and identify repeat visitors by Visitor ID.
- [Agent Commands](https://www.olark.com/help/agent-commands/): See the full list of Olark agent commands, such as !tag, !transfer, !end and !note, and what each does during a chat. Visitors never see the commands.
- [Automation Rules](https://www.olark.com/help/automationrules/): Olark Automation Rules (Legacy) run only on Olark Classic chatboxes. Use them to block visitors, hide the chatbox by location or show it on set pages.
- [Block a Troublesome Chatter](https://www.olark.com/help/blocks/): Stop a troublesome visitor from chatting in Olark, either temporarily for 24 hours with the !block command or permanently with an IP-based Automation Rule.
- [Block an IP Address](https://www.olark.com/help/ip-block/): Copy a visitor's IP address from the chat console and create an Automation Rule to hide the chatbox from them. Rules run on Olark Classic chatboxes.
- [Chat Console Connection Issues](https://www.olark.com/help/connection-trouble/): Fix Olark chat console connection problems like undelivered messages or a Disconnected status, with browser, network and computer checks.
- [Chat Routing Options](https://www.olark.com/help/chat-routing-options/): Choose how Olark assigns incoming chats: first agent to respond or next agent in line, plus per-agent chat limits and routing new chats to a group.
- [ChatGPT Setup Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/mcp-chatgpt/): An admin adds Olark as a custom MCP server in ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, or Edu. You then sign in and ask about your chats.
- [Claude Setup Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/mcp-claude/): Add Olark as a custom connector in Claude, sign in with your Olark account, and ask about your chat transcripts.
- [Connect Olark to your AI assistant with the Olark MCP server](https://www.olark.com/help/mcp-server/): Connect AI assistants to Olark with the Olark MCP server to analyze chat transcripts, spot trends, and create, review and publish Olark AI bots.
- [Copilot Setup Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/mcp-copilot/): Create an agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio, add Olark with OAuth 2.0, and search your chat transcripts.
- [Desktop Notifications and Sounds](https://www.olark.com/help/desktop-notification/): Turn on desktop notifications and sounds for app.olark.com in Chrome, Firefox and other browsers so you never miss an incoming chat.
- [Develop Command](https://www.olark.com/help/develop_command/): Use the Olark !develop command to act as a new visitor, simulate a new visit or page change, and test Automation Rules without clearing cookies.
- [Enable Automatic Translation](https://www.olark.com/help/enable-automatic-translation/): Turn on automatic message translation in the Olark agent console from User Settings and choose your preferred default language in a few steps.
- [Ending a Chat](https://www.olark.com/help/ending/): End an Olark chat with the !end command or the Actions menu to send your chat-ended message, and see when chat sessions end automatically.
- [GSAT - Goal Satisfaction](https://www.olark.com/help/gsat---goal-satisfaction/): Olark's GSAT report uses AI to track which topics customers ask about in chat and whether your team satisfied them. Choose topics and drill into results.
- [New Olark Agent Training Guide](https://www.olark.com/help/ee-new-agent/): A quick training guide for new Olark agents: set your status, navigate My Inbox and Team Inbox, and handle conversations in the updated chat interface.
- [Olark Desktop App](https://www.olark.com/help/olark-desktop-app/): Install Olark as a desktop app from Chrome or Edge on Windows or Mac to answer chats outside a browser tab, pin it to your taskbar or launch it at login.
- [Olark Home](https://www.olark.com/help/olark-home/): See what the Olark Home dashboard reports and how its numbers are calculated, including median chat volume, conversation time and coverage.
- [Olark MCP server: security and privacy for IT teams](https://www.olark.com/help/mcp-security/): What the Olark MCP server can read and change, how sign-in works, the limits, how personal information is handled, and answers to common IT and security review questions.
- [Real-time Tags & Alerts](https://www.olark.com/help/realtime-tags-alerts/): Use Olark Real-time Tags & Alerts to tag chats and notify agents, email or Slack when a visitor asks for a quote, a person or a refund, mid-conversation.
- [Send a transcript to a CRM directly from chat](https://www.olark.com/help/triggers/): Send a chat transcript to one integration with an !integration-name command, list your integrations with !trigger, or send to all with !case or !lead.
- [Send messages Faster with Shortcuts](https://www.olark.com/help/shortcut/): Create Olark Shortcuts that expand into saved greetings, messages or links when you type a semicolon, as team or personal shortcuts. A paid feature.
- [Updating to the New Olark - FAQ](https://www.olark.com/help/migrating-faq/): Answers for teams moving to the New Olark: no extra cost, settings carry over, and a tour of the new dashboard, Behavior, Agent Tools and Integrations.
- [Uploading files](https://www.olark.com/help/file-upload/): Visitors and agents can share files in Olark chat. See supported file types, the 50MB limit, when the upload button appears and how long files are kept.
- [Using Olark Tags](https://www.olark.com/help/tagging/): Label Olark chats with the !tag command to make transcripts easier to search and filter. Covers adding multiple tags and the rules for using them.
- [Visitor Cobrowsing PowerUp](https://www.olark.com/help/cobrowsing/): With the Visitor Cobrowsing PowerUp, Olark agents can ask to view a visitor's screen during a chat. It is a paid add-on you request through support.

## Olark Classic

- [Accessing Visitor IP Addresses in Olark (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/ipaddresses/): In Olark Classic, visitor IP addresses are hidden by default. See how to reveal one to block abusive chatters and use Visitor IDs to spot repeat visitors.
- [Agent Commands (Olark classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/commands/): In Olark Classic, agent commands like !tag, !transfer, !block, !email and !lead let you act during a chat. See the full list and what each one does.
- [Agent to agent chats (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/op2op/): In Olark Classic, agents can message each other from the Agents list in the chat console. These chats are one-to-one and are not saved to transcripts.
- [Block a Troublesome Chatter (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/block/): In Olark Classic, block a troublesome chatter for 24 hours with the !block command, or set up a permanent block by IP address with an Automation Rule.
- [Block an IP Address (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/block-ip/): In Olark Classic, create an automation rule that hides the chat box from specific IP addresses, useful for blocking colleagues or problem visitors.
- [Chat Console Connection Issues (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/connection/): In Olark Classic, troubleshoot chat console connection drops, undelivered messages and Disconnected status caused by browsers, networks or firewalls.
- [Debug Info for Olark Chat](https://www.olark.com/help/chat-debug/): In Olark Classic, open the debug window on chat.olark.com with a keyboard shortcut and copy its contents to share with Olark support when troubleshooting.
- [Desktop Notifications (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/desktop-notifications/): In Olark Classic, enable desktop notifications for new chats and fix blocked notification permissions in Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge.
- [Develop Command (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/develop/): In Olark Classic, the !develop command opens a debugging tool on your site to simulate new visitors, new visits and page changes when testing rules.
- [Emojis](https://www.olark.com/help/emojis/): In Olark Classic, agents and visitors can add emoji to chats by typing codes between colons, like :smile:. See the full list of supported emoji codes.
- [Ending a Chat (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/end/): In Olark Classic, use the !end command to close a chat and send your predefined chat ended message, and see how visitors can end chats themselves.
- [How to add visitor information to the chat console (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/visitor-insights/): In Olark Classic, use the Olark JavaScript API to show visitor names, emails and custom labels in the chat console so agents get more context.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://www.olark.com/help/shortcuts-keyboard/): Keyboard shortcuts for the Olark Classic chat console: move between conversations, toggle available or unavailable and open the help menu.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts in the Chat Console (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/keyboard-shortcuts/): In Olark Classic, use keyboard shortcuts in the chat console to switch conversations, toggle your availability and open the help menu.
- [Live Chat Translation PowerUp](https://www.olark.com/help/live-chat-translation-powerup/): The Live Chat Translation PowerUp for Olark Classic lets agents translate visitor messages and their own replies with dropdowns in each conversation.
- [New Agent Training Guide (Olark classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/new-operator/): A training guide for new agents on Olark Classic, covering the chat console, statuses, the dashboard, team settings and a pre-chat checklist.
- [Pre-chat Survey](https://www.olark.com/help/prechat-survey/): In Olark Classic, set up a pre-chat survey to collect visitor name, email and phone before a chat, site-wide in settings or on specific pages via the API.
- [Safari Notifications (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/safari-notifications/): In Olark Classic, Safari may block chat sound notifications. Allow auto-play for chat.olark.com in Safari's website settings to hear alerts again.
- [Send a transcript to a CRM directly from chat (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/trigger/): In Olark Classic, send a chat transcript to one specific CRM with an !integration-name command, list integrations with !trigger, or send to all.
- [Send Messages Faster with Shortcuts](https://www.olark.com/help/shortcuts/): Create team and personal shortcuts for canned chat replies in Olark and insert them with a semicolon, including how shortcuts work in Olark Classic.
- [The best ways to proactively engage with visitors](https://www.olark.com/help/proactive/): In Olark Classic, start chats proactively by messaging visitors from your visitor list or by setting up Automation Rules that send messages automatically.
- [Using Tags (Olark classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/tags/): In Olark Classic, tag chats with the !tag command to label topics like sales or refund, then filter your transcripts by tag. See the tagging rules.
- [Visitor Cobrowsing PowerUp (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/visitor-cobrowsing-powerup/): In Olark Classic, launch a Visitor Cobrowsing session from the visitor information panel to view a visitor's screen once they accept the request.
- [Visitor Insights PowerUps (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/visitor-insights-powerups/): In Olark Classic, Visitor Insights PowerUps use FullContact to show agents a visitor's social profiles, interests, company and job title.
- [Visitor Profiles (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/visitor-profile/): In Olark Classic, Visitor Profiles store a visitor's name, email, phone and custom fields so any agent can see and update them in future chats.
- [Why does Google Analytics real-time show more visitors? (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/google-analytics-realtime/): In Olark Classic, Google Analytics real-time can show different visitor counts than Olark. Compare how each counts visitors and what else affects totals.
- [Why does Olark not work with Google Hangouts (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/google-hangouts/): In Olark Classic, Google Hangouts can't be used to answer chats because it doesn't support the XMPP protocol. Use a supported client or the chat console.
- [Why is my visitor list empty? (Olark Classic)](https://www.olark.com/help/empty-buddylist/): In Olark Classic, a visitor list may show only chatting visitors on high-traffic sites or free accounts. See why and how to switch back.

(function(){

    play();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-rd-filter]').forEach(function(b){
    if(!b.hasAttribute('aria-pressed')) b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.classList.contains('on')?'true':'false');
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-rd-filter]').forEach(function(x){
        x.classList.remove('on');
        x.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
      });
      b.classList.add('on');
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
      var f=b.getAttribute('data-rd-filter');
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-rd-cat]').forEach(function(c){
        c.classList.toggle('hidden', f!=='all' && c.getAttribute('data-rd-cat')!==f);
      });
    });
  });

   
  var navToggle=document.querySelector('[data-rd-nav-toggle]');
  var mobileMenu=document.getElementById('rd-mobile-menu');
  function menuFocusables(){
    return mobileMenu?Array.prototype.slice.call(mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a[href],button:not([disabled])')):[];
  }
  function setMenuOpen(open){
    if(!navToggle||!mobileMenu) return;
    navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
    navToggle.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Close menu':'Open menu');
    mobileMenu.hidden=!open;
    if(open){
      var items=menuFocusables();
      if(items[0]) items[0].focus();
    }else{
      navToggle.focus();
    }
  }
  if(navToggle&&mobileMenu){
    navToggle.addEventListener('click',function(){
      setMenuOpen(navToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true');
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Escape' && navToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true'){
        e.preventDefault();
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    });
    mobileMenu.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key!=='Tab') return;
      var items=menuFocusables();
      if(!items.length) return;
      var first=items[0], last=items[items.length-1];
      if(e.shiftKey && document.activeElement===first){
        e.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      }else if(!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement===last){
        e.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    });
  }

   
  var lightbox=document.createElement('div');
  lightbox.className='rd-lightbox';
  lightbox.setAttribute('role','dialog');
  lightbox.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  lightbox.setAttribute('aria-label','Image preview');
  lightbox.hidden=true;
  lightbox.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="rd-lightbox-close" aria-label="Close image preview">×</button><img alt=""><div class="rd-lightbox-html" hidden></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(lightbox);
  var lbImg=lightbox.querySelector('img');
  var lbHtml=lightbox.querySelector('.rd-lightbox-html');
  var lbClose=lightbox.querySelector('.rd-lightbox-close');
  var lbReturnFocus=null;
  function openLightbox(src,alt,trigger){
    lbReturnFocus=trigger||document.activeElement;
    lightbox.classList.remove('is-html');
    lbHtml.hidden=true;
    lbHtml.innerHTML='';
    lbImg.hidden=false;
    lbImg.src=src;
    lbImg.alt=alt||'';
    lightbox.setAttribute('aria-label',alt?('Preview: '+alt):'Image preview');
    lightbox.hidden=false;
    lightbox.classList.add('show');
    lbClose.focus();
  }
  function openHtmlLightbox(sourceEl,trigger,label){
    lbReturnFocus=trigger||document.activeElement;
    lightbox.classList.add('is-html');
    lbImg.hidden=true;
    lbImg.removeAttribute('src');
    lbImg.alt='';
    lbHtml.hidden=false;
    lbHtml.innerHTML='';
    var clone=sourceEl.cloneNode(true);
    clone.removeAttribute('role');
    clone.removeAttribute('tabindex');
    clone.removeAttribute('aria-label');
    clone.classList.remove('shot-html');
    clone.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function(s){s.remove();});
    clone.querySelectorAll('.kscan-replay').forEach(function(b){b.remove();});
    var slots=clone.querySelector('.kscan-slots');
    if(slots){
      slots.innerHTML='';
      ['Pricing','Docs','Help'].forEach(function(name){
        var slot=document.createElement('div');
        slot.className='kscan-slot in';
        slot.textContent='✓ '+name;
        slots.appendChild(slot);
      });
    }
    var pw=clone.querySelector('.pw');
    if(pw) pw.classList.add('in');
    lbHtml.appendChild(clone);
    lightbox.setAttribute('aria-label',label||'Expanded preview');
    lightbox.hidden=false;
    lightbox.classList.add('show');
    lbClose.focus();
  }
  function closeLightbox(){
    if(lightbox.hidden) return;
    lightbox.classList.remove('show');
    lightbox.hidden=true;
    lightbox.classList.remove('is-html');
    lbImg.removeAttribute('src');
    lbImg.alt='';
    lbImg.hidden=false;
    lbHtml.hidden=true;
    lbHtml.innerHTML='';
    if(lbReturnFocus && typeof lbReturnFocus.focus==='function') lbReturnFocus.focus();
    lbReturnFocus=null;
  }
  lbClose.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();closeLightbox();});
  lightbox.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(e.target===lightbox) closeLightbox();
  });
  lightbox.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeLightbox();return;}
    if(e.key!=='Tab') return;
     
    e.preventDefault();
    lbClose.focus();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.shot-img').forEach(function(box){
    var img=box.querySelector('img');
    if(!img) return;
    var label=img.alt?('View larger: '+img.alt):'View larger image';
    if(box.tagName==='BUTTON' && !box.getAttribute('aria-label')) box.setAttribute('aria-label',label);
    box.addEventListener('click',function(){openLightbox(img.currentSrc||img.src,img.alt,box);});
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.shot-html').forEach(function(box){
    function activate(e){
      if(e.target.closest('button,a,input,textarea,select')) return;
      var full=box.getAttribute('data-fullsrc');
      if(full){
        openLightbox(full,box.getAttribute('data-fullalt')||'',box);
        return;
      }
      openHtmlLightbox(box,box,box.getAttribute('data-zoom-label')||box.getAttribute('aria-label')||'Expanded preview');
    }
    box.addEventListener('click',activate);
    box.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();activate(e);}
    });
  });

   
  document.querySelectorAll('form.tryform').forEach(function(form){
    var input=form.querySelector('input[name="website"]');
    if(!input) return;
    var errId=input.id?input.id+'-error':'rd-tryform-error';
    var err=form.querySelector('.rd-tryform-error');
    if(!err){
      err=document.createElement('p');
      err.className='rd-tryform-error';
      err.id=errId;
      err.setAttribute('role','alert');
      form.appendChild(err);
    }else{
      err.id=errId;
    }
    input.setAttribute('aria-describedby',errId);
    function clearError(){
      form.classList.remove('is-invalid');
      input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      err.textContent='';
    }
    input.addEventListener('input',clearError);
    form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
      var val=(input.value||'').trim();
      if(!val){
        e.preventDefault();
        form.classList.add('is-invalid');
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid','true');
        err.textContent='Enter your website to continue.';
        input.focus();
        return;
      }
      

      if(typeof window.oaiq==='function') window.oaiq('measure','custom',{type:'custom'},{custom_event_name:'preview_requested'});
    });
  });
})();

<script>
(function () {
  var TEMPLATE_ID = "proof-not-promises";
  var OPEN_DELAY_MS = 5000;
  var STORAGE_KEY = 'olark-site-popup:' + TEMPLATE_ID;

  
  
  var matches = document.head.querySelectorAll('template[data-olark-enticement="' + TEMPLATE_ID + '"]');
  if (matches.length !== 1 || !('attachShadow' in Element.prototype)) return;
  var template = matches[0];
  var BLOCKED_ELEMENTS = 'script, iframe, frame, object, embed, form, input, textarea, select, ' +
    'link, meta, base, foreignObject, animate, set';
  var URL_ATTRIBUTES = ['href', 'xlink:href', 'src', 'action', 'formaction'];

  function readState() {
    try { return sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function writeState(value) {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, value); } catch (e) {}
  }

  
  function widgetShowsCard() {
    var widget = document.querySelector('olark-enticements');
    var root = widget && widget.shadowRoot;
    return !!(root && root.querySelector('[data-olark-view]'));
  }

  var host = null;
  var root = null;

  var FRAME_CSS =
    ':host{all:initial;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999999;pointer-events:none}' +
    
    
    '.corner{position:fixed;left:12px;bottom:12px;padding:8px;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);' +
      'max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;' +
      'pointer-events:auto;animation:rise .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}' +
    '@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.98)}}' +
    
    '@media (max-width:480px){.corner{left:8px;bottom:80px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 92px)}}' +
    '@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.corner{animation:none}}';

  
  function isScriptUrl(value) {
    var scheme = Array.prototype.filter.call(value, function (c) { return c.charCodeAt(0) > 0x20; }).join('');
    return /^javascript:/i.test(scheme);
  }

  function sanitize(fragment) {
    fragment.querySelectorAll(BLOCKED_ELEMENTS).forEach(function (el) { el.remove(); });
    fragment.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(function (el) {
      Array.prototype.slice.call(el.attributes).forEach(function (attr) {
        var name = attr.name.toLowerCase();
        var isHandler = name.indexOf('on') === 0;
        var isScript = URL_ATTRIBUTES.indexOf(name) !== -1 && isScriptUrl(attr.value);
        if (isHandler || isScript || name === 'srcdoc') el.removeAttribute(attr.name);
      });
    });
  }

  
  
  function cloneView(view) {
    var inertCopy = template.content.cloneNode(true);
    inertCopy.querySelectorAll('[data-olark-view]').forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.getAttribute('data-olark-view') !== view) el.remove();
    });
    sanitize(inertCopy);
    return document.importNode(inertCopy, true);
  }

  function render(view) {
    if (!host) {
      host = document.createElement('div');
      host.setAttribute('data-site-popup', TEMPLATE_ID);
      root = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
      document.body.appendChild(host);
    }
    root.innerHTML = '<style>' + FRAME_CSS + '</style>';
    if (view === null) return;
    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'corner';
    container.addEventListener('click', onAction);
    container.appendChild(cloneView(view));
    root.appendChild(container);
  }

  function onAction(event) {
    var target = event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-olark-action]');
    if (!target) return;
    if (!target.matches('a[href]')) event.preventDefault();
    var action = target.getAttribute('data-olark-action');
    if (action === 'expand') {
      render('corner-open');
    } else if (action === 'collapse') {
      writeState('collapsed');
      render('corner');
    } else if (action === 'dismiss') {
      writeState('dismissed');
      render(null);
    }
  }

  var state = readState();
  if (state === 'dismissed') return;
  if (state === 'collapsed') {
    if (!widgetShowsCard()) render('corner');
    return;
  }
  setTimeout(function () {
    if (widgetShowsCard()) return;
    
    writeState('collapsed');
    render('corner');
  }, OPEN_DELAY_MS);
})();
</script>

    function getParameterByName(name, url) {

      if (!results) return null;
      if (!results[2]) return '';

      return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, " "));

<script>
(function () {
  var COOKIE_NAME = 'olark_attribution';
  var COOKIE_MAX_AGE_DAYS = 90;
  var APP_URL = "https://app.olark.com";
  var PREVIEWER_PATH = '/websitepreview';
  var TRACKED_PARAMS = [
    'utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content',
    'oppref', 'gclid', 'fbclid', 'msclkid', 'li_fat_id', 'ttclid'
  ];

  function readCookie() {
    var prefix = COOKIE_NAME + '=';
    var parts = document.cookie.split('; ');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      if (parts[i].indexOf(prefix) === 0) {
        try {
          var parsed = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(parts[i].slice(prefix.length)));
          return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
        } catch (e) {
          return null;
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  

  function cookieDomain() {
    var labels = location.hostname.split('.');
    if (labels.length < 2 || /^\d+$/.test(labels[labels.length - 1])) return '';
    return '; domain=.' + labels.slice(-2).join('.');
  }

  function writeCookie(value) {
    var attrs = '; path=/; max-age=' + (COOKIE_MAX_AGE_DAYS * 86400) + '; samesite=lax' +
      cookieDomain() + (location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; secure' : '');
    document.cookie = COOKIE_NAME + '=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(value)) + attrs;
  }

  function referrerHost() {
    try {
      return document.referrer ? new URL(document.referrer).hostname : '';
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }

  

  function currentTouch() {
    var referrer = referrerHost();
    if (referrer === location.hostname) return null;
    var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    var touch = {};
    var found = false;
    TRACKED_PARAMS.forEach(function (name) {
      var value = (params.get(name) || '').trim();
      if (value) {
        touch[name] = value;
        found = true;
      }
    });
    if (!found) return null;
    touch.landing = location.pathname;
    touch.at = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    if (referrer) touch.referrer = referrer;
    return touch;
  }

  function capture() {
    var touch = currentTouch();
    var existing = readCookie();
    if (!touch) return existing;
    var next = { first: (existing && existing.first) || touch, last: touch };
    writeCookie(next);
    return next;
  }

  function isPreviewerUrl(url) {
    try {
      var app = new URL(APP_URL);
      var target = new URL(url, location.href);
      return target.host === app.host && target.pathname === PREVIEWER_PATH;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function decorate(attribution) {
    var last = attribution && attribution.last;
    if (!last) return;
    var forwarded = TRACKED_PARAMS.filter(function (name) { return last[name]; });
    if (!forwarded.length) return;

    document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(function (link) {
      if (!isPreviewerUrl(link.getAttribute('href'))) return;
      var url = new URL(link.getAttribute('href'), location.href);
      forwarded.forEach(function (name) { url.searchParams.set(name, last[name]); });
      link.setAttribute('href', url.toString());
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('form[action]').forEach(function (form) {
      if (!isPreviewerUrl(form.getAttribute('action'))) return;
      forwarded.forEach(function (name) {
        var input = form.querySelector('input[name="' + name + '"]');
        if (!input) {
          input = document.createElement('input');
          input.type = 'hidden';
          input.name = name;
          form.appendChild(input);
        }
        input.value = last[name];
      });
    });
  }

  if (!window.URLSearchParams || !window.URL) return;
  decorate(capture());
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var wraps = document.querySelectorAll('.kscan-wrap');
  var wrap = wraps[wraps.length - 1];
  if(!wrap) return;
  var el = wrap.querySelector('.kscan');
  var slots = wrap.querySelector('.kscan-slots');
  var replay = wrap.querySelector('.kscan-replay');
  var SOURCES = ['Pricing','Docs','Help'];
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var playing = false;

  function flyOne(i){
    var src = el.querySelector('#kscan-src-'+i);
    if(!src) return;
    var slot = document.createElement('div');
    slot.className = 'kscan-slot';
    slot.textContent = '✓ ' + SOURCES[i];
    slots.appendChild(slot);
    if(reduced){ slot.classList.add('in'); return; }
    var sb = src.getBoundingClientRect(), eb = el.getBoundingClientRect(), db = slots.getBoundingClientRect();
    var chip = document.createElement('div');
    chip.className = 'kscan-chip';
    chip.textContent = SOURCES[i];
    el.appendChild(chip);
    chip.style.left = (sb.left - eb.left) + 'px';
    chip.style.top = (sb.top - eb.top) + 'px';
    chip.style.opacity = '1';
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      chip.style.transition = 'left .5s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.3,1), top .5s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.3,1), opacity .5s ease';
      chip.style.left = (db.left - eb.left + 4) + 'px';
      chip.style.top = (db.top - eb.top + 4) + 'px';
    });
    setTimeout(function(){
      slot.classList.add('in');
      chip.remove();
    }, 520);
  }

  function play(){
    if(playing) return;
    playing = true;
    replay.hidden = true;
    slots.innerHTML = '';
    if(reduced){
      SOURCES.forEach(function(_, i){ flyOne(i); });
      playing = false;
      replay.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    SOURCES.forEach(function(_, i){ setTimeout(function(){ flyOne(i); }, i * 700 + 400); });
    setTimeout(function(){
      playing = false;
      replay.hidden = false;
    }, SOURCES.length * 700 + 900);
  }

  replay.addEventListener('click', play);

  if(reduced || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)){
    play();
  }else{
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if(e.isIntersecting){ io.disconnect(); play(); }
      });
    },{threshold:.45});
    io.observe(wrap);
  }
})();
</script>

    track('Website AI Connector Tour Slide Viewed',{slideNumber:index+1,numberOfSlides:count,slideTitle:slides[index].getAttribute('data-title'),autoplay:!!auto});
    if(index===count-1&&!completed&&!auto){completed=true;track('Website AI Connector Tour Completed',{numberOfSlides:count})}
    
    var shift=Math.floor(selected/count)-MIDDLE;

  var AUTOPLAY_MS=7000;
  var pauseButton=root.querySelector('.ac-tour-pause');
  var live=root.querySelector('.ac-tour-live');
  var stopped=reduceMotion, hovering=false, focused=false, onScreen=false, timer=null;
  function schedule(){

  carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){hovering=false;schedule()});

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-tour-step]').forEach(function(b){

  showSlide(0);updateTabs();setStopped(stopped);
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready)document.fonts.ready.then(layout);
  layout();
})();

  document.querySelectorAll('form.tryform').forEach(function(form){

  }

      if (parts[i].indexOf(prefix) === 0) {

    if (labels.length < 2 || /^\d+$/.test(labels[labels.length - 1])) return '';
    return '; domain=.' + labels.slice(-2).join('.');

    var found = false;

  var lbHtml=lightbox.querySelector('.rd-lightbox-html');
  var lbClose=lightbox.querySelector('.rd-lightbox-close');
  var lbReturnFocus=null;
  function openLightbox(src,alt,trigger){
    lbReturnFocus=trigger||document.activeElement;
    lightbox.classList.remove('is-html');
    lbHtml.hidden=true;
    lbHtml.innerHTML='';
    lbImg.hidden=false;
    lbImg.src=src;
    lbImg.alt=alt||'';
    lightbox.setAttribute('aria-label',alt?('Preview: '+alt):'Image preview');
    lightbox.hidden=false;
    lightbox.classList.add('show');
    lbClose.focus();
  }
  function openHtmlLightbox(sourceEl,trigger,label){
    lbReturnFocus=trigger||document.activeElement;
    lightbox.classList.add('is-html');
    lbImg.hidden=true;
    lbImg.removeAttribute('src');
    lbImg.alt='';
    lbHtml.hidden=false;
    lbHtml.innerHTML='';
    var clone=sourceEl.cloneNode(true);
    clone.removeAttribute('role');
    clone.removeAttribute('tabindex');
    clone.removeAttribute('aria-label');
    clone.classList.remove('shot-html');
    clone.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function(s){s.remove();});
    clone.querySelectorAll('.kscan-replay').forEach(function(b){b.remove();});
    var slots=clone.querySelector('.kscan-slots');
    if(slots){
      slots.innerHTML='';
      ['Pricing','Docs','Help'].forEach(function(name){
        var slot=document.createElement('div');
        slot.className='kscan-slot in';
        slot.textContent='✓ '+name;
        slots.appendChild(slot);
      });
    }
    var pw=clone.querySelector('.pw');
    if(pw) pw.classList.add('in');

    lightbox.setAttribute('aria-label',label||'Expanded preview');
    lightbox.hidden=false;
    lightbox.classList.add('show');
    lbClose.focus();

  function closeLightbox(){
    if(lightbox.hidden) return;
    lightbox.classList.remove('show');
    lightbox.hidden=true;
    lightbox.classList.remove('is-html');
    lbImg.removeAttribute('src');
    lbImg.alt='';
    lbImg.hidden=false;
    lbHtml.hidden=true;
    lbHtml.innerHTML='';
    if(lbReturnFocus && typeof lbReturnFocus.focus==='function') lbReturnFocus.focus();
    lbReturnFocus=null;
  }
  lbClose.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();closeLightbox();});

      openHtmlLightbox(box,box,box.getAttribute('data-zoom-label')||box.getAttribute('aria-label')||'Expanded preview');

    box.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();activate(e);}

  document.querySelectorAll('form.tryform').forEach(function(form){

      form.classList.remove('is-invalid');
      input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      err.textContent='';

    input.addEventListener('input',clearError);
    form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){

        return;
      }
      

      if(typeof window.oaiq==='function') window.oaiq('measure','custom',{type:'custom'},{custom_event_name:'preview_requested'});

    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      if (parts[i].indexOf(prefix) === 0) {

        }

  }

    if (labels.length < 2 || /^\d+$/.test(labels[labels.length - 1])) return '';
    return '; domain=.' + labels.slice(-2).join('.');
